Press Release  
 
 
 
 
      
Brookfield Corporation Reports 16% Increase in Earnings
Record LTM Distributable Earnings Before Realizations of $5.8 Billion
Net Income of $1.9 Billion Reported for the Quarter
$300 Million of Shares Repurchased Since Last Report, Approximately $900 Million Repurchased Year-to-Date
BROOKFIELD, NEWS, November 12, 2026 – Brookfield Corporation (NYSE: BN, TSX: BN) announced strong 
financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Nick Goodman, President of Brookfield Corporation, said, “We delivered strong financial results in the third 
quarter. Our asset management business raised $25 billion, wealth solutions delivered 22% earnings growth, 
and our operating businesses continued to generate resilient cash flows.”
Goodman added, “The current macroeconomic environment plays to our strengths. Our focus on real assets 
with inflation-linked revenues, pricing power, and durable cash flows positions us well for continued growth. We 
continue to reinvest our excess cash flows to compound capital. This included share repurchases of over 
$300 million since we last reported, bringing total share repurchases to almost $900 million so far this year.”
Operating Results 
Distributable earnings (“DE”) before realizations per share increased by 14% and total DE, including 
realizations, increased by 16% per share over the prior-year quarter.

Total consolidated net income was $1.9 billion for the quarter and $5.3 billion for the last twelve months. 
Distributable earnings before realizations were $1.5 billion ($0.64/share) for the quarter and $5.8 billion ($2.47/
share) for the last twelve months.
Asset Management delivered strong results, with fee-related earnings increasing 15% compared to the prior-
year quarter. Growing investor demand for long-duration, essential-service and inflation-protected assets 
supported strong fundraising momentum, with $25 billion of capital raised during the quarter. Fee-bearing 
capital increased to $682 billion at quarter end.
Wealth Solutions continued to scale, with distributable earnings increasing 22% compared to the prior-year 
quarter, supported by continued organic growth, strong investment performance, and the expansion of our 
global insurance platform with the acquisition of Just Group in the prior quarter, bringing total insurance assets 
to nearly $200 billion.
Operating Businesses continued to generate stable and resilient cash flows, supported by strong operating 
fundamentals and the contracted and inflation-linked revenues of our underlying assets.
We realized $222 million of carried interest, net, into income during the quarter, bringing total realized carried 
interest, net, to $588 million over the last twelve months, reflecting continued progress in converting 
accumulated carried interest into earnings. Total distributable earnings were $1.7 billion ($0.73/share) for the 
quarter and $6.4 billion ($2.72/share) for the last twelve months.
Brookfield Corporation  1

Operating Highlights
Asset Management
•
DE was $755 million ($0.32/share) in the quarter and $3.0 billion ($1.28/share) for the last twelve months.
•
Fundraising through the third quarter totaled $123 billion, including $25 billion raised during the quarter, 
reflecting strong demand across our flagship and complementary strategies, including a record $1.2 billion 
raised for our infrastructure private wealth strategy and a record $1.5 billion for our super-core 
infrastructure strategy during the quarter.
•
Subsequent to quarter-end, we received $13 billion of additional commitments for our infrastructure 
flagship strategy, bringing total capital committed to date to $26 billion. We expect to finalize the first close 
in the coming weeks, positioning the fund to become, by far, the largest infrastructure fund ever raised 
globally.
•
Fee-bearing capital increased by 13% to $682 billion at quarter end, driving a 15% increase in fee-related 
earnings compared to the prior year quarter.
Wealth Solutions
•
DE was $511 million ($0.22/share) in the quarter and $1.9 billion ($0.79/share) for the last twelve months.
•
During the quarter, we originated $4 billion of retail and institutional annuity sales, supported by the 
expansion of our distribution platform in the U.S. through new broker-dealer channels. We continue to 
adopt a disciplined approach to organic growth with a primary focus on maintaining a return on our equity 
of 15%+ over the long term.
•
We deployed $13 billion of capital during the quarter, of which $8 billion was invested into real asset 
strategies. The balance primarily being the reallocation of cash and short-duration investments into higher-
yielding U.S. Treasuries. Returns from real asset investments contributed to a 16 basis point increase in 
the total net yield of our investment portfolio (to 5.7%) compared to the prior quarter.
•
Our P&C business maintained strong underwriting performance, achieving a combined ratio of 99.6% 
during the quarter, further diversifying our liability profile and lowering our overall effective cost of funds.
Operating Businesses
•
DE was $467 million ($0.20/share) in the quarter and $1.6 billion ($0.70/share) for the last twelve months. 
•
Cash distributions from our operating businesses continued to be supported by resilient operating 
earnings, underpinned by contracted, inflation-linked revenues and growing demand for the essential 
products and services our businesses provide.
•
Our energy business continues to advance strategic initiatives in nuclear power through Westinghouse, 
including a recently announced framework agreement between Westinghouse, the U.S. federal 
government, and Korea to accelerate nuclear development in the U.S., further strengthening the outlook for 
this business.
•
Operating fundamentals across our real estate portfolio remain strong as growing demand for high-quality 
assets, combined with constrained supply, continues to increase rents for premium assets. During the 
quarter, we completed 5.3 million square feet of office and retail leasing, with net rents across our balance 
sheet office portfolio 16% above expiring levels.
Earnings from the monetization of assets were $222 million ($0.09/share) for the quarter and $588 million 
($0.25/share) for the last twelve months.
•
Year-to-date, we have advanced $53 billion of asset sales across the business, including $20 billion during 
the quarter, realizing significant value for our clients at attractive returns.
•
Monetization activity during the quarter included $4 billion of real estate assets, approximately $5 billion of 
infrastructure assets, approximately $4 billion of energy assets, $3 billion of private equity investments, and 
$4 billion of credit investments.
•
As we continue to return capital to our clients through asset monetizations, a number of our funds are 
moving closer to carried interest realization. Total gross accumulated unrealized carried interest grew by 
approximately $525 million to $13.0 billion at quarter end, net of realizing $222 million of net carried interest 
into income during the quarter.
Brookfield Corporation  2

We ended the quarter with $207 billion of capital available to deploy into new investments. 
•
Our $207 billion of deployable capital includes $5.4 billion of liquidity at the Corporation, $86.9 billion of 
cash, financial assets, and undrawn credit lines across our affiliates, and $114.3 billion of uncalled private 
fund commitments. 
•
Our balance sheet is conservatively capitalized, with corporate debt at the Corporation carrying a weighted-
average term of 14 years and no remaining maturities in 2026.
•
We have extremely strong access to capital markets, completing $37 billion of financings across the 
franchise during the quarter. At the Corporation, we issued $600 million of five-year senior unsecured notes 
at a spread of 82 basis points over the benchmark, one of our lowest spreads ever. The offering was 
approximately four times oversubscribed, underscoring strong investor demand and the strength of our 
credit profile.
•
Since we last reported, we repurchased over $300 million of BN Class A shares in the open market, 
bringing total year-to-date share repurchases to $889 million.
Corporate Simplification Update
•
Brookfield Corporation expects to complete its previously announced corporate simplification transaction 
(the “Transaction”) on December 1, 2026, subject to all closing conditions being satisfied or waived. Class 
A shares of Brookfield Corporation Ltd. are expected to begin trading on the NYSE and TSX under the 
symbol “BN” on December 3, 2026. 
•
Eligible Canadian and UK shareholders who wish to participate in the Transaction on a tax-deferred basis 
must complete their elections by 5:00 p.m. (EST) on November 25, 2026. Further information and election 
instructions are available on Brookfield's website. All other shareholders, including U.S. shareholders, are 
not required to take any action.
•
In connection with the Transaction, Brookfield Corporation’s dividend reinvestment plan (“DRIP”) will 
terminate on November 17, 2026. Participants will receive cash in lieu of fractional shares based on the 
November 16, 2026 TSX closing price. 
Regular Dividend Declaration
Shareholders of record as of the close of business on December 16, 2026 (the “Record Date”) will receive a 
cash distribution of $0.07 per share on December 31, 2026. The Board of Brookfield Corporation declared the 
regular monthly and quarterly dividends on our preferred shares.

About Brookfield Corporation
Brookfield Corporation is a leading global investment firm focused on building long-term wealth for institutions 
and individuals around the world. We have three core businesses: Asset Management, Wealth Solutions, and 
our Operating Businesses which are in infrastructure, energy, private equity, and real estate.
We have a track record of delivering 15%+ annualized returns to shareholders for over 30 years, supported by 
our investment and operational experience. Our conservatively managed balance sheet, extensive operational 
experience, and global sourcing networks allow us to consistently access unique opportunities. At the center of 
our success is the Brookfield Ecosystem, which is based on the fundamental principle that each group within 
Brookfield benefits from being part of the broader organization. Brookfield Corporation is publicly traded in New 
York and Toronto (NYSE: BN, TSX: BN).
Please note that Brookfield Corporation’s previous audited annual and unaudited quarterly reports have been 
filed on EDGAR and SEDAR+ and can also be found in the investor section of its website at 
www.bn.brookfield.com. Hard copies of the annual and quarterly reports can be obtained free of charge upon 
request.

Non-IFRS and Performance Measures
This news release and accompanying financial information are based on IFRS Accounting Standards, as 
issued by the IASB, unless otherwise noted.
We make reference to Distributable Earnings (“DE”). We define DE as the sum of distributable earnings before 
realizations from our asset management business and our wealth solutions business, distributions received 
from our ownership of investments, realized carried interest and realized disposition gains, net of earnings from 
our Corporate Activities, preferred share dividends and equity-based compensation costs. We also make 
reference to DE before realizations, which refers to DE before realized carried interest and realized disposition 
gains. Distributable earnings before realizations from our Asset Management business is comprised of fee-
related earnings, realized carried interest, net and investments and other income (expenses), net of cash taxes 
and equity-based compensation costs from BAM, as well as return on capital from cash distributions received 
on direct investments. Distributable earnings from our Wealth Solutions business is calculated as net income 
from our Wealth Solutions business, excluding the impact of depreciation and amortization, deferred income 
taxes, net income from our equity accounted investments, mark-to-market on investments and derivatives, 
breakage and transaction costs, and is inclusive of our proportionate share of DE from investments in 
associates. We believe these measures provide insight into earnings received by the company that are 
available for distribution to common shareholders or to be reinvested into the business. 
Realized carried interest and realized disposition gains are further described below:
•
Realized Carried Interest represents our contractual share of profits generated within a private fund after 
achieving our clients’ minimum return requirements. Realized carried interest is determined on third-party 
capital that is no longer subject to future investment performance.
•
Realized Disposition Gains are included in DE because we consider the purchase and sale of assets to be 
a normal part of the company’s business. Realized disposition gains include gains and losses recorded in 
net income and equity in the current period, and are adjusted to include fair value changes and revaluation 
surplus balances recorded in prior periods which were not included in prior period DE, and exclude 
amounts attributable to direct investments and non-controlling interests unless otherwise noted.
We use DE to assess our operating results and the value of Brookfield Corporation’s business and believe that 
many shareholders and analysts also find this measure of value to them. 
We disclose a number of financial measures in this news release that are calculated and presented using 
methodologies other than in accordance with IFRS. These financial measures, which include DE, should not be 
considered as the sole measure of our performance and should not be considered in isolation from, or as a 
substitute for, similar financial measures calculated in accordance with IFRS. We caution readers that these 
non-IFRS financial measures or other financial metrics are not standardized under IFRS and may differ from 
the financial measures or other financial metrics disclosed by other businesses and, as a result, may not be 
comparable to similar measures presented by other issuers and entities.
We provide additional information on key terms and non-IFRS measures in our filings available at 
www.bn.brookfield.com.
